home.text: We did not create a collection. We created one singular artifact, distilled across four years of field research across three continents.
"Every drop carries the fingerprint of the wind that shaped it."— Our Master Perfumer

The signature artifact begins its life in the arid highlands of Iranian saffron fields. Every petal is hand-picked at dawn, before the desert heat dissipates the volatile oils that make this single scent truly unrepeatable.
"Time is our rarest ingredient. We cannot rush what must mature."— Our Cellar Master

After extraction, the concentrated essence matures inside hand-blown Venetian glass for a minimum of eighteen months. This slow aging allows the molecular structure to evolve into the deep amber character our patrons have come to recognize as the mark of authenticity.
"The most enduring artifacts are not purchased. They are inherited."— Our Founder

When applied to skin, the artifact reacts uniquely to each wearer. What emerges is a scent that cannot be replicated, cannot be photographed, and cannot be sold to anyone else. This is why we produced only one thousand vessels — each one numbered, each one singular.

An earthy, sun-baked opening of warm Iranian saffron, wet terra-cotta powder, and raw golden resins — matured for eighteen months in hand-blown Venetian glass and numbered individually for its sole owner.
Every botanical compound sourced from its native micro-climate.
Murano masters shape each glass, celebrating natural imperfections.
Only 1,000 vessels produced, each archival-numbered for its owner.
Refill service and archival repurchasing rights for the original holder.
"It smells genuinely like warm dust and fine old book binding after an afternoon in an artist's studio."
"Quiet, perfectly mineral, and incredibly unique. It catches people entirely off guard."
"A breathtakingly realistic crisp green imprint completely free of mainstream sweetness."
Art holds no structural gender. Our composition reacts uniquely to individual skin chemistry, establishing an intimate profile designed without arbitrary industrial labels.
How does fluid aging alter the profile?

Because we implement high concentrations of live botanical extractions, our formulation evolves across time. Dark elements grow increasingly deep and ambery, altering character over decades like fine oils.
Every artifact is dispatched within three business days, wrapped in archival tissue and sealed in wax-stamped linen casing to protect its molecular integrity during transit.
Yes. We offer a thirty-day return window on unopened vessels. If the seal remains untouched, we will refund the total value including dispatch, no questions asked.
Join the fewer than 1,000 patrons who will ever hold this artifact.
